description: This file defines the 'Error' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup' namespace. It handles error and exception processing by setting custom handlers, logging errors, and controlling error display and redirection based on configuration settings.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A controller class for handling errors and exceptions during the startup phase of the admin interface in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up error and exception handlers, initializes logging based on configuration, and prepares error handling routines.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Custom error handler that logs PHP errors, displays them based on configuration, and redirects if necessary.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions by logging and displaying them, or redirecting as configured.
